comment: The three e2e scan cases every channel runs. Each case is scanned as: ashx scan --source-dir <a copy of fixtures/SOURCE> --output-dir <scratch> --no-progress --scanners SCANNERS ARGS, with ENV set. scripts/e2e/run_case.py appends ARGS, so every channel that uses it passes them; a channel that builds its own command line must append them too. scripts/e2e/assert_outcome.py --case NAME checks the result. The incomplete trigger, and why its ARGS turn opengrep on, are measured in tests/e2e/README.md.
